description: This file defines UTF-8 string handling helper functions within the Opencart System.Helper.Utf8 namespace, including functions for string length, position, substring, and case conversion.

classes.name: Opencart	ype unction
classes.description: A collection of UTF-8 string manipulation functions in the namespace Opencart	ype unction.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a UTF-8 string using mb_strlen.

methods.name: strpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring in a UTF-8 string using mb_strpos.

methods.name: strrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the last occurrence of a substring in a UTF-8 string using mb_strrpos.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a portion of a UTF-8 string using mb_substr.

methods.name: strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to uppercase using mb_strtoupper.

methods.name: strtolower
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to lowercase using mb_strtolower.
